test_cases.title: Ticking Generate Invoices shows Invoice Generation in Manage Contracts
acs: DERIVED: The Generate Invoices role adds Invoice Generation to the Manage Contracts menu and the page opens (MasterContent.master.vb:50)
assumptions: The admin site runs at http://localhost:1946 and the user is signed in as an Admin (Windows identity dt2\ns000134). Only the Admin role is ticked for this user; the menus are compared with the Navigations pictures.

Role change: the test ticks and unticks roles for the signed-in user in Manage Roles (saved immediately, the user is signed in again) and always restores them in cleanup. It runs after the other admin tests because it changes the user they run as.

steps.action: Open Manage Roles and find your own row.

steps.expected: The role is saved and you are signed in again.
The menu lists Customers, Search, Group Addresses, Exports and Invoice Generation.

test_cases.title: Unticking Generate Invoices hides Invoice Generation again
acs: DERIVED: Removing the Generate Invoices role removes Invoice Generation from the Manage Contracts menu (MasterContent.master.vb:50)
assumptions: The admin site runs at http://localhost:1946 and the user is signed in as an Admin (Windows identity dt2\ns000134). Only the Admin role is ticked for this user; the menus are compared with the Navigations pictures.

Role change: the test ticks and unticks roles for the signed-in user in Manage Roles (saved immediately, the user is signed in again) and always restores them in cleanup. It runs after the other admin tests because it changes the user they run as.

steps.action: Open Manage Roles and tick Generate Invoices for yourself.

steps.expected: The menu lists Customers, Search, Group Addresses and Exports only.

steps.action: Check the page for a server error message.
steps.expected: No server error page is shown.

steps.action: Cleanup: make sure only Admin is ticked.

test_cases.title: Ticking one more role leaves every section menu unchanged
acs: DERIVED: Ticking Contracts Admin, Scheme Admin, Scheduling, Internal User, Test Consultant, Assessor, Results Sign-off, Support or Override Schemes does not change the System Administration, Manage Contracts, Manage Schemes or Distributions menus (the side menus only gate Invoice Generation by role)

Data table: the Examples table of the matching scenario outline lists every row; each row is one execution.

Read the menu of each section.
steps.expected: The items match the Navigations pictures (Manage Contracts without Invoice Generation).
